goal.en: Use the vocabulary that carries academic and analytical writing, with the precision it demands.
goal.ar: أن تستخدم مفردات الكتابة الأكاديمية والتحليلية بالدقة التي تتطلبها.

text.en: A few hundred words do most of the work in academic English. They are not difficult words; they are precise ones, and using the wrong one changes the argument rather than only the tone.
text.ar: بضع مئات من الكلمات تؤدي معظم العمل في الإنجليزية الأكاديمية. وهي ليست كلمات صعبة بل دقيقة، واستعمال الخطأ منها يغيّر الحجة نفسها لا النبرة فقط.

head: Word
Means
Not
rows: consist of, be made up of

text.en: “Comprise” already means “consist of”, so “is comprised of” is redundant to careful readers. Write “comprises” or “consists of”.
text.ar: comprise تعني أصلاً «يتألف من»، فعبارة is comprised of زائدة عند القارئ المدقّق. اكتب comprises أو consists of.

text.en: “Subsequent” means later in time; “consequent” means caused by. A subsequent fall came afterwards; a consequent fall was caused by what came before.
text.ar: subsequent تعني «لاحق زمنياً»، وconsequent تعني «ناتج عن». فالانخفاض subsequent جاء بعد، والانخفاض consequent سببه ما قبله.

text.en: Academic English packs actions into nouns so they can be counted, qualified and made the subject of a sentence. This is a tool, not an ornament — and overused it becomes fog.
text.ar: الإنجليزية الأكاديمية تكثّف الأفعال في أسماء لتُعدّ وتُوصف وتصير فاعلاً للجملة. وهي أداة لا زخرفة، وإفراطها يصنع ضباباً.

text.en: The plural of “analysis” is “analyses”, and the same pattern covers hypothesis, thesis and crisis. The -is becomes -es.
text.ar: جمع analysis هو analyses، وينطبق النمط نفسه على hypothesis وthesis وcrisis، فتصير is إلى es.

text.en: Two nominalisations in a row usually hide who did what: “the implementation of the evaluation of the policy”. Put one action back into a verb.
text.ar: توالي اسمين مشتقين يُخفي عادةً من فعل ماذا، مثل the implementation of the evaluation of the policy. أعِد أحد الأفعال إلى صيغته الفعلية.

text.en: Match the verb to the evidence, not to how strongly you feel. A single study cannot demonstrate anything; it can indicate.
text.ar: طابق الفعل بقوة الدليل لا بقوة اقتناعك. فدراسة واحدة لا تُثبت demonstrate بل تُشير indicate.

text.en: Hedging is not weakness. Overclaiming is the error a reader punishes, because one overclaim makes every other claim suspect.
text.ar: التحفّظ ليس ضعفاً، بل المبالغة هي الخطأ الذي يعاقب عليه القارئ، لأن مبالغة واحدة تجعل بقية الدعاوى موضع شك.

items.en: The findings are consistent with earlier work.
A number of participants reported the same effect.
items.ar: أبلغ عدد من المشاركين عن الأثر نفسه.

explanation.en: Constitute = make up. Consist needs “of”, and “comprised of” is the redundant form.
explanation.ar: constitute تعني «يشكّل»، وconsist تحتاج of، أما comprised of فصيغة زائدة.

prompt.en: “The subsequent decline” tells you the decline was…
prompt.ar: عبارة the subsequent decline تعني أن الانخفاض…

explanation.en: Subsequent is purely about order in time. Caused by would be “consequent”.
explanation.ar: subsequent تتعلق بالترتيب الزمني فقط، أما الناتج عن الحدث فهو consequent.

questions.sentence: The term ___ from a Latin root meaning “to carry”.

explanation.en: Derive from = originate in. Deprive means take away from someone.
explanation.ar: derive from تعني «ينحدر من»، أما deprive فتعني الحرمان.

prompt.en: An “underlying assumption” is one that is…

explanation.en: Underlying means beneath the surface — present and load-bearing, but not said.
explanation.ar: underlying تعني «كامن تحت السطح»: موجود وحامل للمعنى لكنه غير مصرَّح به.

options: The board is comprised of nine members.
The board consists of nine members.
Nine members make up the board.

explanation.en: Comprise already contains “of”, so adding it repeats the meaning.
explanation.ar: comprise تتضمن معنى of أصلاً، فإضافتها تكرار للمعنى.

questions.sentence: Her ___ of the results differs from mine.

explanation.en: After a possessive you need the noun form.

questions.sentence: Three separate ___ produced the same result.

explanation.en: Words ending -is take -es in the plural: analysis → analyses.
explanation.ar: الكلمات المنتهية بـ is تُجمع بـ es: analysis تصير analyses.

prompt.en: Give the noun from the verb “acquire”.

explanation.en: Acquire → acquisition, as in “second language acquisition”.
explanation.ar: acquire تصير acquisition كما في second language acquisition.

prompt.en: Which sentence is clearer without losing formality?
prompt.ar: أي جملة أوضح دون أن تفقد الرسمية؟

options: We evaluated the policy before implementing it.
The implementation of the evaluation of the policy occurred.
There was an implementation of the policy evaluation.
The policy evaluation implementation was carried out.

explanation.en: One verb restores the actor and the order of events. Stacked nouns hide both.
explanation.ar: فعل واحد يعيد الفاعل وترتيب الأحداث، أما تكديس الأسماء فيُخفي الاثنين.

prompt.en: Match the verb to its noun.

explanation.en: None of these endings is predictable from the verb, which is why they are worth memorising as pairs.
explanation.ar: لا يمكن توقّع أي من هذه اللواحق من الفعل، ولهذا تُحفظ أزواجاً.

prompt.en: A single small study found an effect. Which sentence reports it responsibly?
prompt.ar: دراسة صغيرة واحدة وجدت أثراً. أي جملة تنقل ذلك بمسؤولية؟

options: These findings indicate a possible effect.
These findings prove the effect is real.
These findings demonstrate the effect clearly.
These findings settle the question entirely.

explanation.en: One small study can indicate; only a body of work can demonstrate.
explanation.ar: دراسة صغيرة واحدة تُشير indicate، ولا يُثبت demonstrate إلا تراكم الأعمال.

prompt.en: Which phrase makes the weakest claim?

explanation.en: “Consistent with” only says the evidence does not contradict the claim.
explanation.ar: consistent with تقول فقط إن الدليل لا يناقض الدعوى.

questions.sentence: ___ participants reported mild side effects, though most did not.

explanation.en: The second clause says most did not, so only a vague minority quantifier fits.
explanation.ar: الشطر الثاني يقول إن الأغلبية لم تُبلغ، فلا يناسب إلا لفظ أقلية غير محدد.

options: This one experiment proves the theory.
This experiment is consistent with the theory.
This experiment points towards the theory.

explanation.en: A single experiment cannot prove a theory, and saying so costs the writer credibility everywhere else.
explanation.ar: تجربة واحدة لا تُثبت نظرية، والادعاء بذلك يكلّف الكاتب مصداقيته في بقية النص.

questions.answer: The study revealed a substantial gap between the two groups

explanation.en: “Substantial” means large and significant here — not “physical”.
explanation.ar: substantial تعني هنا «كبير وذو دلالة» لا «مادي».
